'''Chapter 1038''' is titled "Kid & Law vs. Big Mom".

==Cover Page==
[[Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion]], Vol. 3: "Niji & Yonji are held captive in Chocolat Town on Cacao Island"

[[Vinsmoke Niji|Niji]] and [[Vinsmoke Yonji|Yonji]] are captured by the [[Big Mom Pirates]] and imprisoned by [[Charlotte Mont-d'Or]]'s [[Buku Buku no Mi|abilities]].

==Short Summary==
A recovered [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] and [[Franky]] each go to try and help [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], who sees what appears to be the Grim Reaper standing over him. Meanwhile, [[Izou]] escapes from the first floor crawlspace into the basement, where he encounters the two [[CP0]] agents; although they say they will leave him alone, Izou confronts them to protect his [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance|comrades]]. Elsewhere, [[Yamato]] makes it to the [[Skull Dome#Bottom Floor|Armory]] just in time to stop [[Fude Fude no Mi#Techniques|Kazenbo]], and begins battling the flaming entity.

On the [[Skull Dome#Live Floor|Live Floor]], [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] has overwhelmed [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] and prepares to go up to the roof to aid [[Kaidou]]; however, the two [[Super Rookie|Supernovas]] muster the energy to stop her and unleash more powerful attacks that cause harm to her.

==Long Summary==
On the third floor, both [[Raizo]] and [[Fukurokuju]] have caught fire, though the former is burning more than the latter. Fukurokuju demands Raizo release him or they will both die, but Raizo stands his ground.

On the second floor, the [[samurai]] try to flee from the burning castle, just as part of the ceiling comes down. Thankfully, [[Jinbe]] protects them, and as they escape, Jinbe wonders how the fire is spreading so fast. On the [[Skull Dome#Live Floor|Live Floor]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]'s side effects finally wear off, and he returns to normal, much to [[Tristan]] and [[Miyagi]]'s relief. Chopper, however, expresses more concern over [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] since the super medicine he was given earlier would make him feel even more pain when they wore off. He begs for Zoro not to die, though Zoro wakes up and notices what appears to be the grim reaper preparing to slay him, and he himself cannot move at all. Thankfully, [[Franky]] is making his way to his position.

In the First Floor attic, [[Izou]] has defeated the [[Beasts Pirates]] but sustained injuries himself. His attention is turned, however, to the presence of the [[CP0]] agents. [[Guernika]] admits that while they cannot technically ignore a former member of the [[Whitebeard Pirates]], their priorities are the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] and decide to leave him alone. Izou, however, refuses to let them out of his sight.

In the Basement [[Skull Dome#Bottom Floor|Armory]], [[Yamato]] has reached it, but so has [[Kurozumi Kanjuro|Kanjuro]]'s [[Kazenbo]]. Yamato uses '''Namuji Hyoga''' to freeze the [[explosive]]s with ice but the Kazenbo starts melting it. Yamato uses '''[[Takeru#Techniques|Mahobora]]''' to hurt it, and it manifests a hand and slathers Yamato with its fire.

On the Live Floor, [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] and [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] are on the ground defeated by [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]], while their respective crews plead with her to show mercy. Big Mom, however, laughs at the patheticness of their begging and uses '''Tenman Daijizai Tenjin''' to defeat the two crews. Afterwards, she decides to ride [[Hera]] back up to the roof to help [[Kaidou]] finish [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], having deduced they were still fighting for so long. But before she can go, Law once again uses '''K-ROOM: Anesthesia''' to extend his [[Kikoku|sword]] and pierce Big Mom through her arm and head. He then uses '''Shock Wille''' again to electrocute her and make her bleed again. All the metal [[Homies]] try to attack Law in retribution but they are pulled towards Kid, who manages to get back up again. He forms a giant bull with the metal and rams into Big Mom with '''[[Jiki Jiki no Mi#Techniques|Punk Corna Dio]]''', slamming her into a wall. He also says to her that he believes Kaidou is reaching his limit, comparing him and her to a mountain that gets worn down by the rain, meaning that both [[Four Emperors|Emperors]] have no doubt been taking a lot of damage from these fights. Kid and Law then proclaim that no matter what and even if they die, they will not let her reach the roof.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*The fight between [[Raizo]] and [[Fukurokuju]] continues.
**Both become engulfed in flames.
*[[Jinbe]] assists in the evacuation of some [[samurai]] trapped in the second floor of [[Kaidou]]'s castle.
*[[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] returns to normal.
**Chopper is worried about how the side-effects of the [[Mink Tribe|Mink]]'s medicine is affecting [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro's]] body.
*Zoro wakes up and sees a hooded skeleton wielding a [[Polearm#Scythe|scythe]] ready to strike him.
**[[Franky]] heads towards Zoro's location.
*[[Izou]] defeated the [[Beasts Pirates]] in the first floor crawlspace.
**Izou encounters [[CP0]], who proceed to ignore him due to their mission concerning only the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], but he stops them.
*[[Yamato]] and [[Fude Fude no Mi#Techniques|Kazenbo]] reach the [[Skull Dome#Bottom Floor|weapon vault]].
**Yamato transforms into his [[Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami|Human-Beast Form]] and freezes some [[Explosive#Bombs|bombs]].
**Yamato starts fighting Kazenbo.
*The fight between [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] against [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] continues.
**After knocking out Law and Kid, Big Mom uses [[Hera]] to attack the nearby [[Heart Pirates|Heart]] and [[Kid Pirates]].
**Big Mom heads to the roof, but is stopped by Law and Kid.
***Law uses [[Ope Ope no Mi|his powers]] to extends his sword and uses it to stab Big Mom in the cheek and electrocute her.
***Kid uses [[Jiki Jiki no Mi|his abilities]] to force away the steel-beam [[homies]] and attack Big Mom with a bull-like mech.
